text:
Priya Rao: FYI - artifact-scan flagged service-account tokens embedded inside model-builder image layers produced by the 'model-artifact-builder' job. Affected tags discovered in internal registry. Severity: P1. Please treat as action-required.

sec-bot: Automated detection: artifact-scan v3.2.1 -> rule 'embedded-credentials' triggered (confidence=0.92). Findings: 6 blobs across tags model-x:cache-2026-04-05*, model-y:staging-*. Ticket SEC-2026-827 created.

Ethan Liu: Root cause quick summary: a helper script in buildpack did `tar -czf /output/layer.tar /` during image layer assembly; dockerignore didn't exclude `/var/run/secrets`. The builder runs on our CI runners which mount projected serviceaccount tokens. So tokens ended up in layer blobs and pushed to the internal OCI registry.

Priya Rao: Immediate mitigation (owners: infra + ops-sre):
- Revoke/rotate the short-lived tokens for the service accounts that ran on the builder runners.
- Delete the offending image tags/blobs from the internal registry and mark them as untrusted.
- Trigger rebuild of affected images after patching the buildpack.
- Block future pushes from the current builder job until linter checks are in place.

infra-ci: Patch PR open: https://git.internal/infra/ci/pulls/2089 (adds .dockerignore entries, buildpack change to avoid absolute tar of /, and a pre-push artifact-scan gate). CI job id: build-55213. ETA to merge: 2 hours.

ops-sre: Rotation plan:
- List affected SA keys in SEC-2026-827. We will revoke the ServiceAccount tokens by restarting the runner pods (they obtain new projected tokens) and rotate any long-lived credentials that were linked. Commands (ops runbook):
```
# revoke registry access tokens
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \ 
  https://registry.internal/api/v1/tags/delete -d '{"tags": ["model-x:cache-2026-04-05", "model-y:staging-02"]}'

# restart runners to force projected token refresh
kubectl rollout restart deployment/ci-runners -n ci
```
Note: We will NOT revoke cluster-level SA keys without confirming scope.

Sam Irwin: Customer impact note: Hosted API + Dedicated customers not impacted. Private customers who used our on-prem buildkit with cached artifacts might be affected. We'll send a scoped customer advisory for Private customers after we confirm the set of exposed artifacts. Draft comms in SEC-2026-827 -> customer-comm.md.

Priya Rao: Long-term controls to implement (owners: infra + eng-runtime + devex):
- Enforce artifact-scan as a required check in all CI merges.
- CI runner pod security: drop mounts to host paths that contain secrets, ensure minimal projected token lifetimes, run builds in ephemeral VM with no SA tokens mounted where possible.
- Add a linter that fails build if /var/run/secrets or similar globs are included in image layers.
- Update our onboarding docs for model publishers about not copying host filesystem roots into layers.

Ethan Liu: I've added a pre-build hook that verifies dockerignore entries and runs `tar --exclude=/var/run/secrets` if legacy scripts are used. PR: https://git.internal/infra/buildpacks/pull/460. Rebuild pipeline queued: build-55218.

sec-bot: Reminder: after rotation and purge run `artifact-scan verify --ticket SEC-2026-827 --clusters all` and attach report to the ticket.

ops-sre: Deleted 4 tags and scheduled blob GC on registry for midnight UTC. Rebuilds of affected images in progress; first green build in staging at 2026-04-05T12:34:00Z. Revokes applied to runner serviceaccounts at 2026-04-05T12:50:00Z.

Priya Rao: Deadline: revoke + purge + rebuilds must be complete by EOD UTC 2026-04-06. If your team cannot meet this, escalate to @security-lead. Please add any discovered tags to SEC-2026-827.

Sam Irwin: I'll prepare the private-customer advisory and legal-safe wording. No proactive broad customer notice until we confirm any customer-owned credentials in the blobs.

Ethan Liu: Postmortem follow-up items added to infra backlog: RB-1123 (runner token hardening), RB-1124 (artifact-scan as pre-push), RB-1125 (buildpack audit). Assigning owners now.

Priya Rao: Thanks all. We'll run a short tabletop on this pattern next security sync to avoid repeats. Follow-up in SEC-2026-827.
